scope: Admin catalog: hard delete (unreferenced) + archive fallback (referenced)

businessFlow.subject: Catalog rows now offer Delete (hard delete) alongside Archive; unreferenced records are removed and referenced records are blocked with a clear in-use error
steps: sign in as demo admin (email + password + development MFA code 123456)
create a fresh unreferenced category via the labeled form
click Delete on that fresh category and verify it disappears from the list
click Delete on a referenced category (Import Verify Cat, which has a product model)
verify the category is NOT deleted and the banner reads "This record is still referenced. Use Archive instead."
verify the only console error is the expected 409 from the blocked delete

notes: Delete maps to DELETE .../:id?purge=1 (hard delete), blocked by FK RESTRICT -> 409 CATALOG_IN_USE for referenced rows; Archive remains the soft-delete fallback. No cascade delete. Fixed a pre-existing async currentTarget.reset() bug in the create form.
